subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The success and achievements of a school mostly ________ on its experience and resourcefulness.
solution:
The correct answer is '**depend**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**depend**" means to be contingent on or determined by. (निर्भर होना)
 
• The success and achievements of a school are generally contingent on its experience and resourcefulness.
 
• The other options: "**credit**," "**achieve**," and "**begin**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The success and achievements of a school mostly depend__ on its experience and resourcefulness.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Credit (श्रेय)**: means acknowledgment or praise given for some achievement.
 
• **Achieve (प्राप्त करना)**: means to successfully reach a desired objective.
 
• **Begin (शुरू करना)**: means to start or initiate something.
